name: Amphibious
source: Pathfinder Howl of the Wild, Amphibious adjustment (pg. 122), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=24
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Howl of the Wild is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds the amphibious trait (removing aquatic), low-light vision, Athletics equal to its highest skill modifier, a swim Speed of half its land Speed if it has none and a land Speed of half its swim Speed if it has none (minimum 15 feet), and Drag Along.

abilities.name: Drag Along
abilities.description: Requirements {Name}'s previous action was a successful melee Strike; Effect {Name} Strides or Swims 10 feet away from the target. The target moves the same direction and distance as forced movement.
